mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level consistently signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed maintains accommodative stance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion characterized by high housing starts and strong retail sales indicates overvalued equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as profit-taking accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600k and RSAFS > 600,000 and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate consistently indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and low federal funds rate signals economic slowdown prompting monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing weakness that reduces economic growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
